name: RES Multistep Ancestral
plain: RES aimed at σ_down, with fresh noise added back to σ' each step. The multistep history uses the previous σ_down rather than the σ the noise landed on. Default η=1.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
t=−log σ, φ₁(z)=(e^z−1)/z, φ₂(z)=(φ₁(z)−1)/z. t_d=−log σ_down, h=t_d−t, c₂=(t_{i−1}−t_old)/h where t_old=−log(previous σ_down). b₁=φ₁(−h)−φ₂(−h)/c₂, b₂=φ₂(−h)/c₂ (NaN→0).
get_ancestral_step: σ_up=min(σ', η·√(σ'²(σ²−σ'²)/σ²)); σ_down=√(σ'²−σ_up²); η=0 returns (σ', 0).
First step or σ_down=0: x'=x+d(σ_down−σ). Otherwise x'=e^{−h}x+h(b₁D+b₂D_old). If σ_up>0: x'+=n·s_noise·σ_up (s_noise×noise_scale).

props.prediction_space: x0 in −log σ with VE renoise
props.final_sigma0: Explicit: σ_down=0 Euler equals D; σ_up=0, no noise.
props.flow_const: No CONST branch and no RF dispatch: VE get_ancestral_step and additive noise run on flow σ.

label: from code
surprise: Ancestral noise here has no RF branch, unlike euler_ancestral, dpm_2_ancestral and dpmpp_2s_ancestral.
